name: CIGO product-validation intake
steps: Visitor opens the campaign page and watches the approved vertical presenter.
Visitor submits idea, budget, currency, optional email, follow-up choice, and consent.
Invalid fields are rejected and stored as a failure. No record is created.
A repeated idea and email returns the original id.
A new idea is stored in SQLite with a unique cigo_ id.
If follow-up is email, a notification is prepared and marked not sent.
Records, alerts, and failures can be exported as JSON or CSV.

records.idea: A neighborhood bakery wants a weekly specials note drafted for the owner to approve.
A tutor wants parent reminder drafts prepared, with the tutor approving each send.
A small clinic wants intake questions turned into a checklist the owner reviews.

alerts.body: Owner review recorded. No follow-up was requested, and no email was sent.
Follow-up prepared for tutor@example.com. It was not delivered.
Follow-up prepared for desk@example.com. It was not delivered.
